title: Western
story: Howdy, partner: a sunny day in a friendly frontier town.

sensitive.name: Saloon Doors
sensitive.why: They signal a bar and alcohol. Some parents and some faith or cultural groups may not want a children's game to feature drinking venues.

sensitive.name: Jail Door
sensitive.why: Imprisonment can upset players with incarcerated family members. It also isn't a cozy image for young children.
